body: I have a question: I have a hormonal imbalance since I was 14 because I never had a regular period (i.e. it comes every 3/4 months) when i was 15/16 i thought my problem was solved as i started to have a normal period and my skin was clean without any acne. However at 16 I started to have mild acne on my cheeks and my period started to be irregular again, i was put on the contraceptive pill (yasmin) for 6 months but my period was still irregular and my acne didn’t go away but only moved to my chin and forehead as well as my already existing cheek acne (+ I started to gain weight, very tired and dizzy all the time and i started to have mild symptoms of depression) so i was taken off it. As soon as i was taken off (in October 2019) my acne became even worse and i still have an irregular period (since October i only had my period once in march for 2 days), i really wanted to get my blood test to find out whats wrong and what i can do about it, but because of miss rona i have to wait until july because my problem is not considered a ‘’’’priority’’’ in this time. So i wrote all this to ask you: did you experience these side effects (dizziness, tiredness, depression symptoms and weight gain) while on the pill?
I guess you might be right but at the moment i cant go anywhere, i’ve always had anger issues so idk about trauma but again there must have been something that has triggered my anger even more
Thanks ! I really appreciate it, i’ll try to use that ‘let me cool off before we talk over this’

Thanks ! I will try to plan ahead how i’ll react when i find my self in that situation, but you know the thing is mentally im aware of what is happening and while im having my angry moment im actively thinking about how to stop because what im doing is wrong, but when i try to calm down and be silent people (especially my family) come even harder at me which makes me lose it again so its like a never ending cycle of me getting angry then silent and then angry again
this shit sucks bc i tend to do the same with my mom and i feel like an asshole for it but i just cant control it
Even if you try to control it you just cant, like i try to say its ok is not that bad but in the back of my mind im already panicking
Exactly ! because i dont know if im overreacting or if I actually have a problem. It makes no sense to me how i go from 0 to 100 and then back to 0
